```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("../../content/totaltool.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
navigation = data.get("navigation", {})
cards = data.get("cards", [])

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def page_url(value):
    """Convert internal .qmd links to rendered .html links."""
    value = str(value or "")
    parts = urlsplit(value)

    if parts.path.endswith(".qmd"):
        parts = parts._replace(path=parts.path[:-4] + ".html")

    return urlunsplit(parts)

def image_url(value):
    """Resolve image paths relative to the TOTAL project directory."""
    value = str(value or "")

    if value.startswith(("https://", "http://", "/")):
        return value

    return str(PurePosixPath(value))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# NAVIGATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------

nav_links = ""

for link in navigation.get("links", []):
    target = page_url(link.get("url"))
    active = " active" if target == "totaltool.html" else ""

    nav_links += f"""
    <a class="cw-totaltool-tab{active}"
       href="{safe(target)}">
      {safe(link.get('label'))}
    </a>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PROJECT CARDS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

card_html = ""

for card in cards:
    buttons_html = ""

    for button in card.get("buttons", []):
        buttons_html += f"""
        <a class="cw-totaltool-card-btn"
           href="{safe(page_url(button.get('url')))}">
          {safe(button.get('label'))}
          <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        </a>
        """

    card_html += f"""
    <article class="cw-totaltool-card">
      <h3>{safe(card.get('title'))}</h3>
      <p>{safe(card.get('description'))}</p>

      <div class="cw-totaltool-card-actions">
        {buttons_html}
      </div>
    </article>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# HERO PHOTO CREDIT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

caption_html = safe(hero.get("image_caption"))

if hero.get("credit_url"):
    caption_html += (
        f' · <a href="{safe(hero.get("credit_url"))}" '
        f'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">'
        f'{safe(hero.get("credit_link_label", "Contact"))}</a>'
    )

if hero.get("credit_suffix"):
    caption_html += f' {safe(hero.get("credit_suffix"))}'

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-totaltool">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-totaltool-topbar">

    <a class="cw-totaltool-brand" href="totaltool.html"
       aria-label="TOTAL homepage">
      <span class="cw-totaltool-brand-name">TOTAL</span>
      <span class="cw-totaltool-brand-subtitle">
        Temperature Observations To Avoid Loggerheads
      </span>
    </a>

    <nav class="cw-totaltool-tabs"
         aria-label="TOTAL navigation">
      {nav_links}
    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="cw-totaltool-hero">

    <img
      src="{safe(image_url(hero.get('image')))}"
      alt="{safe(hero.get('image_alt'))}"
      class="cw-totaltool-hero-image"
    >

    <div class="cw-totaltool-hero-overlay">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

    </div>

    <span class="cw-totaltool-image-caption">
      {caption_html}
    </span>

  </section>

  <!-- PROJECT RESOURCES -->
  <section class="cw-totaltool-section"
           aria-label="TOTAL project resources">

    <div class="cw-totaltool-card-grid">
      {card_html}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
